prompt: Our research lab needs to organize six key findings from recent experiments into the team's knowledge management system. All six notes (written in Chinese) are listed in the file `/workspace/task_brief.txt`. Please add every note to the system, then mark the two high-priority notes (identified in the brief) as starred/important. Once that's done, perform a strict search that returns only entries touching BOTH '蛋白质' AND '深度学习' simultaneously — save those results to `search_results.txt` in /workspace. Also run the association discovery feature and save its output to `related_output.txt` in /workspace, and run a system status check saving its output to `status_output.txt` in /workspace. The knowledge management tool is installed at `/opt/memory-indexer/`.
